Usage: phax [options] [command]

Drive AI coding agents through isolated, gated phases

Options:
  -V, --version                                  output the version number
  --verbose                                      Print human-readable progress and system events
  --trace                                        Write structured JSONL trace events to the run folder
  --usage                                        Print the phax.usage.kdl CLI spec and exit
  --usage-format <format>                        Format for --usage output: kdl (default, no external dependency) or json (requires the usage CLI) (default: "kdl")
  --json-schema                                  Print the program's contracts as JSON Schema, or a command's after its name, and run nothing
  -h, --help                                     display help for command

Commands:
  validate [options]                             Validate phax.json and its user overlays without any side effects; pass --plan to also validate a phax-plan.json
  unlock [options] <short-name>                  Remove a stale run lock; use --force to remove any lock
  enter [options] <short-name>                   Resume the final phase's agent session interactively
  enter-phase [options] <short-name> <phase-id>  Resume a specific phase's agent session interactively
  session-info [options] <short-name>            Print session diagnostics for a run (state, phase, worktree, session id)
  shell [options] <short-name>                   Open a shell in the final worktree
  path [options] <short-name>                    Print the final worktree path (script-friendly, one line)
  open [options] <short-name>                    Open the final worktree in the configured editor
  ls [options]                                   List runs from the registry
  archive [options] <short-name>                 Archive a run that is not running; --force is required for an unfinished run
  prune [options] [short-name...]                Delete archived runs of the current namespace for real, freeing their names and disk space
  cost                                           Manage the runs' cost ledgers
  run [options] [short-name]                     Extract a plan from plan.md and run all phases, or preview with --dry-run
  review-handoff [options] <short-name>          Regenerate review-handoff.md and global file reconciliation for a review_open run
  publish-pr [options] <short-name>              Push the final branch and create (or reuse) a GitHub PR for a review_open run
  review-compliance [options] <short-name>       Run a plan-compliance review for a review_open run and record its result
  review-code [options] <short-name>             Open an interactive, pre-prompted code-review session for a review_open run, or run the review headless with --headless
  adjust-plan [options] <plan>                   Open an interactive session to adjust a plan after a landed run
  brief [options] [path...]                      Ask the configured brief provider for the rules over the given paths and the findings there; with no path, inside a phase, the phase's brief
  architecture [options] [path...]               Ask the configured architecture provider for the repository's architecture; with paths, for the parts that hold them
  init [options]                                 Create phax.json and phax.schema.json in the current directory
  report [options] [short-name]                  Open a GitHub issue from local telemetry (run semantic.jsonl or latest daily journal)
  completions [options] <shell>                  Generate a shell completion script (zsh, bash, fish, nu, powershell). Requires the usage CLI.
  resume [options] <short-name>                  Resume a run from its next pending phase
  reset-phase [options] <short-name> [phase-id]  Reset a stuck or failed phase so phax resume re-runs it from scratch
  agent                                          Inspect and manage model routing and provider configuration
  security                                       Security-related commands
  skills                                         Manage PHAX skills
  schema                                         Manage the local phax.schema.json
  artifact                                       Inspect and transition the lifecycle status of a spec or plan
  plans                                          Lint, estimate and lay out a plan, and report plan staleness and cross-plan overlap
  records                                        Manage phax run records
  help [command]                                 display help for command
